inputs.text: Job Sikhala is right to oppose amendments that could keep Emmerson Mnangagwa in power until 2030. Extending a leader’s tenure would deepen the concentration of power among political elites, while ordinary people—especially those already shut out of decision-making—would have less influence over their own future. Zimbabwe needs an open debate and strong institutions that protect everyone’s right to choose who governs them.
